messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Whoo hoo!{01 00 00 0f 00} The big {ff 00 00 03}countdown
{ff 00 00 00}is today! {07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Get ready for a
two-year party!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Juhhei!{01 00 00 0f 00} Suur {ff 00 00 03}pöördloendus
{ff 00 00 00}on täna! {07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Valmistu
kaheaastaseks peoks!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tonight another long year
comes to an end.

You know,{01 00 00 05 00} as {ff 00 00 06}mayor{ff 00 00 00}, I have
to take responsibility even
for the passage of time{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Täna õhtul saab järjekordne
pikk aasta otsa.

Tead,{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 06}linnapeana{ff 00 00 00} pean ma
vastutama isegi aja
kulgemise eest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Go get some earmuffs,
sprout! {01 00 00 0a 00}There's gonna be a
lotta shouting tonight!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mine hangi kõrvaklapid,
võsuke! {01 00 00 0a 00}Täna õhtul tuleb
palju karjumist!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've just been staring at
my watch since morning!

{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}But that's just what we
management-types do!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Olen hommikust saadik
oma kella jõllitanud!

{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Aga just seda meie,
juhtivad tegelased, teemegi!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Still,{01 00 00 05 00} though...{07 16 00}{01 00 00 05 00}was I
supposed to start the
{ff 00 00 03}countdown{ff 00 00 00} this early?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuigi{01 00 00 05 00}...{07 16 00}{01 00 00 05 00}kas ma pidin
{ff 00 00 03}pöördloendust{ff 00 00 00} nii
vara alustama?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm a little punchy from
counting all day. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}Whooee! It
goes straight to my head!
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}But if you don't do this,
then the new year simply
doesn't come!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Olen terve päeva lugemisest
veidi uimane. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}Ohoo! See lööb
otse pähe!
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Aga kui sa seda ei tee,
siis uus aasta lihtsalt
ei tulegi!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}We've less than an hour
before the year ends,
{04 00 00}.
So if you have anything
left to do,{01 00 00 05 00} stop yammering
at me and hop to it!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Aastavahetuseni on jäänud
vähem kui tund,
{04 00 00}.
Nii et kui sul on veel
asju teha,{01 00 00 05 00} jäta mind rahule
ja tegutse!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} only a few
precious moments remain
in this year!
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Don't forget to use the
bathroom BEFORE we get to
the big moment!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} sel aastal on
jäänud vaid mõni
kallis hetk!
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ära unusta WC-s ära käia
ENNE, kui suur hetk
kätte jõuab!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It's not too late! {01 00 00 0a 00}If you
want to hear my bit about
smelt, {01 00 00 05 00}there's still time!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Pole veel hilja! {01 00 00 0a 00}Kui tahad
kuulda mu juttu tindist,
{01 00 00 05 00}siis aega on veel!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ahh, glory be!{01 00 00 0f 00} Why,{01 00 00 05 00} it's a
whole new year!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ahh, au ja kiitus!{01 00 00 0f 00} Näe,{01 00 00 05 00} on
täitsa uus aasta!

messages.en:
Allow me to take this
opportunity to say{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. {07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Party
time!{01 00 00 0a 00} Whoo! Party!

{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Happy New Year,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 00 00}! I prepared a
New Year's fortune for you!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Head uut aastat,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 00 00}! Valmistasin sulle
uusaastaennustuse!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}However,{01 00 00 05 00} you have too many
letters right now, so I
can't give it to you.
{07 0e 00}What a bother{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuid{01 00 00 05 00} sul on praegu liiga
palju kirju, nii et ma ei
saa seda sulle anda.
{07 0e 00}Milline tüli{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}So, {01 00 00 05 00}what's your fortune for
the year, sprout?!

{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Goodness! Now you've even
got me all excited!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Nii, {01 00 00 05 00}mis on sinu ennustus
selleks aastaks, võsuke?!

{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Heldeke! Nüüd oled sa
ka minu põnevile ajanud!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Par-tay!{01 00 00 0a 00} WhooEEE!{01 00 00 0a 00} Par-tay
in the New Year!{01 01 00}{07 00 00} I lose
all inhibitions at parties!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Pi-du!{01 00 00 0a 00} JuhhEII!{01 00 00 0a 00} Pi-du
uuel aastal!{01 01 00}{07 00 00} Pidudel
kaotan ma igasuguse piiri!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Well, I'm hoping this will be
a good year for me{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. But
really, how could it not be?
messages.et:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Noh, loodan, et sellest
tuleb mulle hea aasta{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Aga
kuidas saakski teisiti olla?

messages.en:
Sprout! You must "get down"
for the {ff 00 00 03}countdown{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 14 00}Let me give you something
to commemorate the event!
messages.et:
Võsuke! Sa pead
{ff 00 00 03}pöördloenduseks{ff 00 00 00} hoo sisse
saama!
{07 14 00}Las ma annan sulle midagi
selle sündmuse mälestuseks!

messages.en:
Now, take this and use it
to get this {ff 00 00 03}countdown
{ff 00 00 00}started right!
messages.et:
Nüüd võta see ja kasuta,
et {ff 00 00 03}pöördloendus
{ff 00 00 00}korralikult käima panna!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}There's no party like a New
Year's party! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}Because a
New Year's party goes on...
{07 03 00}for TWO YEARS! {01 00 00 0a 00}Use this to
keep things rolling!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Pole paremat pidu kui
uusaastapidu! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}Sest
uusaastapidu kestab...
{07 03 00}KAKS AASTAT! {01 00 00 0a 00}Kasuta seda,
et asi käima hoida!

messages.en:
{ff 00 00 07}Party poppers{ff 00 00 00}!{01 01 00}{07 0b 00} How 'bout it,
sprout? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0a 00}It's not a party
without {ff 00 00 07}party poppers{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{ff 00 00 07}Paugutid{ff 00 00 00}!{01 01 00}{07 0b 00} Mis sa arvad,
võsuke? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0a 00}Pole pidu ilma
{ff 00 00 07}paugutiteta{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:

not {ff 00 00 07}party poppers{ff 00 00 00}?!{01 01 00} {07 03 00}Heh heh
